page_id.description: The ID of the page containing the form

section_id.description: The section ID of the form

form_data.description: The form data to be updated

oneOf.description: Legacy unused file-name list; uploads travel outside form_data
File-field instruction on update: omit the field to keep files; {"remove":true} clears all; {"remove_indexes":[0]} drops those indexes (then an upload appends for multi-file or replaces for single).

update_based_on.description: Fields to use for identifying the record to update

record_id.description: Explicit target record id (record edit mode). Updating your own record is always allowed; updating another user's record requires the form section to opt out of own_entries_only AND UPDATE permission on the form's data table.

expected_version.description: Required: the record version the change is based on (the `version` the client last received from the record or from the list). An update that names none, or a value that is not a whole number of at least 1 (also as multipart text), is refused with 400 (`expected_version_required` / `invalid_expected_version`) before anything is stored; one based on an older version is refused with 409 (`stale_version`). Nothing is written, uploaded or scheduled by a refused update. The schema declares it optional only so that the refusal carries its reason.

preview.description: Act on the draft of the page instead of its published version. Only for a signed-in person who may read the draft; it must match what the person is looking at (the page endpoint's `preview`). Without it the published version is used. The page access rights, the live data and the permissions stay the same.
